_comment: This is a fragment, not a full settings file: merge the "hooks" object below into the user-level ~/.claude/settings.json. It belongs there rather than in a project file because the sessions being watched live in arbitrary repositories, not in this one. Two consequences follow. First, the SessionStart command names its script by a drive-rooted absolute path: a hook runs with the monitored session's own project as its working directory, so a relative path resolves against the wrong repository for every session this project exists to watch, and an environment variable in its place would mean the executed path is attacker-controllable on a machine where anything can set one. That absolute path is specific to this checkout; Section 7's installer substitutes the real one, and wrapper/Enter-ClaudeSession.ps1 refuses to launch when it disagrees with the checkout it is running from. Second, these hooks fire for every session on the machine, including ones started without the wrapper: those carry no CHANNEL_PROCESS_TOKEN, and hooks/session-start.ps1 exits without opening a socket while the broker answers the http hooks with a 400 it ignores. Every url here must agree with broker/config.ts's DEFAULT_PORT and hooks/session-start.ps1's own literal; settings-fragment.test.ts pins all three together, because a hook posting into a port nothing is listening on fails silently and makes a working session look unannounced.
